deliberateWaits: action-execute: one 5.1 s wait (fixed start window, late permit)
action-late: one concurrent ~15 s wait (create/read deadlines)
action-recovery: one ~35 s DB-clock wait for all scenarios
action-cli: one ~35 s DB-clock wait overlapping the journey
implementationChoices: No migration; roles.sql/readiness widened only to the history triggers' mutable columns plus verification/mock INSERT.
ActionPorts is a trusted in-process dependency; the CLI always composes the built-in store; no env/flag/file selects a port; tests wrap it (TEST-ONLY).
Recovery also rechecks deployed versions and the exact stored binding (drift refuses, outcome preserved).
verify: DISPATCH_RESERVED or candidate-with-known-original -> ACTION_STATE_CONFLICT; UNKNOWN without candidate -> ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; NOT_DISPATCHED -> ACTION_NOT_DISPATCHED.
A missing ticket is MISMATCH; non-whitelisted/non-synthetic replies, exceptions and timeouts are FAILED.
Abandon safe codes: ACTION_VERIFICATION_FAILED (recovery) and ACTION_STATE_CONFLICT (superseded by the first late original).
A late original differing from a VERIFIED candidate is not attached (conflict audit only); the same ID attaches provenance.
Publication failures after a possible create keep fixed ACTION_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT/ACTION_AUDIT_FAILED, otherwise ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; state stays for recovery.
action-execute awaits a timed-out invocation's late result for at most 20 s (35 - 15); action-execute/verify exit 0 only for VERIFIED.

reservation.ts additions (accepted source): dispatch carries executor/correlation IDs; takeReservationPermit returns a spent dispatch only for a late first use; reserveAction also returns its permit expectation.
residualRisks: Real wall-clock deadlines are exercised by bounded waits; no caller clock control exists, so exact boundary instants are not tested.
Known-rollback retries are proven with trigger-raised 40001/40P01 at the audit insert, not with an organically produced deadlock inside a publication.
A process exit while a late create result is still pending loses that observation; recovery after 35 s plus candidate evidence is the designed path.
Accepting ActionPorts as a library parameter is an in-process trust boundary; reviewers should confirm it satisfies "no custom ports".
MOCK evidence only: no vendor wire schema, token routing, notifications, production idempotency, retention or operational readiness is claimed.
